title: Receive the cooling that effort could not earn
summary: After all the searching and technique, patience arrives as mercy: holy company cools the body, settles the mind, and makes room for joy.
takeaway: Stop multiplying methods long enough to receive the company that cools you.
lifeApplication: When agitation sends you looking for another fix, pause the search and return to the practice, person, or sangat that actually leaves your mind and body cooler.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy brings holy company, and that meeting cools the mind and body into patience.
source.lifeApplication: When agitation rises, do not add another technique; move toward what has proven cooling and truthful.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy brings holy company, and that meeting cools the mind and body into patience.
evidence.turn: Let the exhausted search become received cooling rather than another performance.
evidence.practicalImplication: When agitation sends you looking for another fix, pause the search and return to the practice, person, or sangat that actually leaves your mind and body cooler.
